title: Add GPU occupancy & kernel-queue metrics plus token-hotspot explorer dashboard
author: Leah Chen
description: Motivation: long-tail latency and unexplained token cost spikes are often correlated with transient kernel queue congestion and uneven GPU occupancy across shards. This PR instruments kernel-queue depth and per-kernel GPU occupancy metrics, enriches spans with kernel-queue snapshots, and surfaces a new Token Hotspot Explorer dashboard that correlates per-token cost/latency with kernel-queue events and model shard occupancy. Changes include: 1) runtime: lightweight kernel-queue depth meter and GPU occupancy sampler with adaptive sampling to limit overhead; 2) tracer: span enrichment with kernel-queue snapshots and occupancy tags; 3) telemetry pipeline: new metrics (kernel_queue_depth, kernel_queue_latencies, gpu_occupancy_pct) and label dimensions (model_variant, shard_id, region, token_bucket); 4) dashboards: Token Hotspot Explorer (token-cost vs kernel-queue, occupancy heatmap, top-k tokens by cost bump); 5) alerts: new burst-aware SLO filter that suppresses noisy short-lived queue spikes and a tuning guide to adjust quiet-window thresholds per deployment tier; 6) tests and docs: unit tests for sampler, integration test that replays synthetic queue bursts, and docs in observability runbook. Backwards compatibility: metrics are additive and opt-in via observability.config.enabled_metrics. Rollout plan: canary on dedicated infra (10% of traffic) for 48h, monitor cost and latency impact then full rollout. Checklist: [x] runtime sampler implemented [x] span enrichments added [x] metric exporters wired [x] dashboard panels created [x] integration tests added [x] runbook entry drafted. Impact: low steady-state overhead (<0.6% CPU on runtime in local benchmarks) and improved SLO RCA fidelity for 95th-99.9th percentiles.

release_notes: Added GPU occupancy and kernel queue metrics plus a Token Hotspot Explorer dashboard to correlate per-token cost and latency with kernel-level queueing events. New burst-aware quiet-window filter for alerts and rollout guidance included. Opt-in via observability.config.enabled_metrics.
testing_summary: Unit tests for sampler and enricher added; integration test replays synthetic kernel queue bursts and asserts span enrichment and metric emission; local perfbench shows <0.6% CPU overhead under typical load; canary run recommended.
deploy_plan: Canary 10% on dedicated cluster for 48h -> monitor token-cost delta and SLO regressions -> full rollout. Feature gated by observability.config.enabled_metrics and observability.feature_flags.token_hotspot_explorer.
notes_for_oncall: If SLO noise increases after enablement, disable observability.feature_flags.token_hotspot_explorer and escalate to runtime@. Look for integration-test timeouts as a sign of synthetic generator instability.
